surfaceAdditions.reason: The part reads `id` for the id of its control while the input is inside the popup, so it is a declared prop. Base UI reads it from the native attributes of the trigger, and `types.md` has no row for a native attribute.
The slot renders each filtered item with `{ item, index }`. It replaces the function child of the list in Base UI.
The part registers `id` with its group for `aria-labelledby`, so it is a declared prop. Base UI reads it from the native attributes of the label, and `types.md` has no row for a native attribute.

returnTypeDifferences.reason: Base UI documents the return type as `AutocompleteFilter`. The composable returns `Filter`, and `AutocompleteFilter` is that type under another name.
`setup` runs one time, so a plain array does not follow a change of the filtered items. The composable thus returns a `ComputedRef` of the array.
